Softening the Inner Critic

For anyone who talks to themselves more harshly than they would ever talk to a friend. Each day gives you one way to notice the critical voice and answer it with something kinder and more honest.

Self-Compassion · Self-Compassion · Self-Esteem · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Write down the exact words your inner critic used today. Notice its tone.
  • Day 2Put your hand on your heart for thirty seconds and say silently, "This is hard right now."
  • Day 3Think of something you did imperfectly today and say, "That is what learning looks like."
  • Day 4Write one sentence to yourself that you would write to a friend who made the same mistake.
  • Day 5Notice when you call yourself a name today and replace it with your actual first name.
  • Day 6List three things you did today that were good enough. Not perfect. Good enough.
  • Day 7When the critic speaks, ask it: "Whose voice is this really?" Sometimes it is someone from long ago.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Read back over your notes from this challenge and write one line about how the critic's voice has changed.
  • Day 60Recall a compliment you brushed off in the past month and write it down as if it were true.
  • Day 120Notice when you minimize a success today with "it was nothing," and correct it to "I worked at that."
  • Day 240Write a kind message to a version of yourself from a hard time, and read it as if it were addressed to you now.
  • Day 365Recognize one moment today where you were generous with yourself, and let it be a pattern rather than a fluke.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
